name: Cloudflare Observability
description: Cloudflare's observability server queries Workers logs and analytics so the agent can debug a deployment from its own telemetry.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (observability.mcp.cloudflare.com) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
